kazakhstan.title: Flag of the Republic of Kazakhstan

colors.note: Represents the endless sky, peace, tranquillity, and unity of the Kazakh people
The sun, the steppe eagle, and the national ornamental pattern

desc:
- Sky blue field with a golden 32-rayed sun above a soaring golden steppe eagle, and a vertical band of national ornamentation along the hoist
- Adopted on 4 June 1992 shortly after independence from the Soviet Union

countryData.name: Kazakhstan
countryData.location: Central Asia, straddling the Europe-Asia boundary

trivia:
- Designed by Shaken Niyazbekov, the flag was chosen from more than a thousand competition entries
- The sun has 32 rays, traditionally associated with abundance and warmth
- Kazakhstan is the world's largest landlocked country by area, stretching nearly 3,000 km across the Eurasian steppe
